title: Stephen stood in truth when it cost everything.
paragraphs:
Stephen stood in truth when it cost everything.
While stones flew, he chose forgiveness.
His strength wasn’t in resistance — it was in surrender.

Some people walk away under pressure.
Others reveal who they really are.

When pressure hits your life…
does your faith react — or reveal?

Stephen didn’t defend himself.
He looked up.

They threw stones.
He gave grace.
Anyone can be calm when life is smooth.

But when you’re misunderstood…
judged…
pressed…
Some of you are in that moment now.
“Pressure doesn’t create faith. It reveals it.”
